The '''10S Technical Institute''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ten South]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Polneye]]. It was destroyed along with the city during an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] by the [[Yevetha]] during the [[Black Fleet]] [[Black Fleet Crisis|Crisis]].
